The '''Ballas Snitch''' is a minor character in {{SA}}.

==History==
===Background===
The snitch was previously a member of the [[Grove Street Families]], until he turned on the families and subsequently joined the [[Ballas (3D Universe)|Ballas]], their main enemies.

===Events of ''Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas''===
In the mission [[Doberman]], after [[Carl Johnson]] takes over [[Glen Park]], the snitch will try to make a run for it, saying that [[Community Resources Against Street Hoodlums|C.R.A.S.H.]] set him up. However, he ends up getting killed by Carl.

==Prominent Appearances in Gameplay==
*[[Doberman]] <small>(Killed)</small>
